wide.label: Closely fitting layer pocket fingertips
wide.mounting: Retain the original narrow CAD mounting spine and boss; add 3.2 mm cap walls outside the inside cavity
wide.whole_layer_provenance: Factory: three 31.8 mm columns, four touching 15.8 mm brick widths; operator dimensions
wide.whole_layer_center_note: The middle column is the layer center. Original n_m column poses and motion jobs are unchanged.
wide.inside_reach_status: Operator confirmed 20 mm inside reach per individual fingertip along the closing direction, 2026-10-27
wide.inside_height_status: Derive from original CAD side profile; operator explicitly requires all three walls to retain the previous gripper side profile
wide.minimum_opposing_clearance_status: Explicit simulation travel guard; not a measured feature of the physical part
wide.shape: Existing tapered cap profile and ceiling; passive guide spacing derived from assembled-layer span with positive clearance; underside open
wide.source_body_backplane_provenance: Existing fingertip_visual.body_mount_cad_x_mm, original scene_config.json; nominal CAD mounting plane
wide.source_pad_backplane_provenance: Existing CAD registration stock_pad_backplane_abs_finger_y_m; terminal native collision box cropped only inside this metal-support plane

ceiling.clearance_sign: Positive when fingertip bottom is above brick bottom at the established grasp
ceiling.rule: new thickness = 17.45 mm + verified fingertip-to-brick-bottom clearance; original upper surface stays fixed
ceiling.pending_adjustment_status: Fixed-top 17.45 mm + verified-clearance calculation retained but not activated; latest request changes only side spacing

pocket_fit.guide_clearance_status: Provisional simulation design allowance: 0.2 mm per passive side; not a measured manufacturing tolerance
pocket_fit.span_rule: measured assembled-layer span + total guide clearance; nominal whole_layer_size_m[0] used only for an explicitly marked preview
pocket_fit.axis: Between opposite end walls within one fingertip, across the three brick columns
pocket_fit.span_approval_evidence: Operator confirmed: 95.8 mm is good; interpreted as approval of the proposed clear pocket span, not an assembled-layer measurement

plate.tape_extent: Only the confirmed overlap on the plate is modeled; outside tape width is unspecified
plate.position_continuity: Operator reports plate taped at the same table location; retain RL photo-derived display transform

selection: Environment and fingertips are independent explicit arguments. No hardware detection selects a scene.
